en.headline: Central Kowloon Bypass fully opens 6 December at 7am completing Route 6
en.dek: The Transport Department said the Kowloon Bay section will open at 7am on 6 December, with a flat HK$8 toll for all vehicles and peak journeys from Tseung Kwan O to Yau Ma Tei cut to about 12 minutes.
body: The Central Kowloon Bypass will be fully commissioned at 7am on 6 December, the Transport Department announced on Friday, marking the completion of Route 6 linking Tseung Kwan O, Kowloon East and Kowloon West.

The final section is the Kowloon Bay section, an approximately 3.4-kilometre dual two-lane trunk road that includes a 3.1-kilometre tunnel. Once open, a flat toll of HK$8 will apply to all vehicles throughout the day via the HKeToll system.

Deputy Commissioner for Transport Leung Sai-ho said the full route is expected to divert traffic from existing corridors such as the Kwun Tong Bypass. He noted that the already-open Yau Ma Tei section had already produced a 20 percent diversion effect, and that teams would continue monitoring traffic with surveillance systems and surveys.

Authorities said the Yau Ma Tei section will be closed from midnight to 7am on the opening day for final preparations, including updates to traffic signs and road markings as well as work on the HKeToll system. Peak-hour journeys between Tseung Kwan O town centre and Yau Ma Tei are expected to fall from about 65 minutes before the project to about 12 minutes.

zh.headline: 中九龍繞道十二月六日上午七時全線通車 完成六號幹線
zh.dek: 運輸署表示，九龍灣段將於十二月六日上午七時開通，所有車輛劃一收費八元，將軍澳往油麻地繁忙時段車程預計縮至約十二分鐘。
body: 運輸署周五宣布，中九龍繞道將於十二月六日上午七時全線通車，標誌著連接將軍澳、九龍東及九龍西的六號幹線正式完成。
最後開通的是九龍灣段，全長約3.4公里的雙程雙線主幹道，其中包括3.1公里隧道。通車後，所有車輛全日劃一透過HKeToll繳付八元隧道費。
運輸署副署長梁世豪表示，全線開通後可望分流觀塘繞道等現有主要幹道的車流。他指油麻地段通車後已觀察到約兩成的分流效果，當局會繼續透過交通監察系統及調查隊伍緊密監察情況。
當局表示，通車當日午夜至上午七時，油麻地段將暫時封閉，以便更新交通標誌及道路標記，並進行HKeToll系統最後準備工作。繁忙時段由將軍澳市中心往返油麻地的行車時間，預計由工程前約65分鐘大幅縮短至約12分鐘。
